text: If you add cinnamon and cayenne pepper to your garbage can then you can repel
mice and flies. If you dip a cotton ball in peppermint oil and leave it in your window sill
it can repel spiders and ants. If you put bay leaves in your pantry then you can repel weevils
and moths. If you set out a bowl of apple cider vinegar and dish soap you can trap fruit flies.
